name: Kahris' Apps
subtitle: Native game ports for iPhone and iPad
description: Native game ports for iPhone and iPad, maintained by Kahris. Game data is not included; each app links to its setup guide. Some apps are designed for iPad only.

apps.name: KartPad
apps.subtitle: Mario Kart Wii for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Mario Kart Wii on iPhone and iPad, built on WiiCompiled, with Metal rendering, touch controls, motion steering and controller support. Optional Retro Rewind content is installed separately.

Requires your own supported PAL RMCP01 revision 0 game image. No disc image or Retro Rewind content is included.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Adds aligned mobile settings, Original Time Trial ghost import/export, expanded controller mappings, FPS counter sizing and clearer diagnostic reporting.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: KartPad connects to your selected private Wii server and other players on your local network.

apps.name: HarkinianPad
apps.subtitle: Ocarina of Time for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Ocarina of Time on iPhone and iPad through Ship of Harkinian, with Metal rendering, touch controls, controller support and Files-based ROM import.

Requires your own legally obtained supported Ocarina of Time ROM. No game data is included. This is a developer preview.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/harkinianpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 5 improves controller ownership after sleep, disconnect and foreground resume. Broader physical controller testing remains open.

apps.name: GoldenPad
apps.subtitle: GoldenEye 007 for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
GoldenEye 007 on iPhone and iPad, built on GoldenEye64Recomp with RT64 Metal rendering, touch controls and controller support.

Import your own supported original US retail ROM; the app prepares its runtime copy locally. No ROM or extracted retail graphics and audio are included. This is a developer preview.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/goldenpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 9 rebuilds the Apple apps from pinned maintained dependencies and makes required game-patch selection reliable. This release does not claim to fix unrelated graphics or crash reports.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: GoldenPad uses your local network to discover and connect to nearby LAN Netplay Lab rooms.

apps.name: SunPad
apps.subtitle: Super Mario Sunshine for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Super Mario Sunshine on iPhone and iPad through ahead-of-time recompilation and a Dolphin-derived runtime, built with ModernGekko and DolRecomp. Includes Metal rendering, touch controls and controller support.

Requires your own supported GMSE01 USA revision 0 ISO/GCM. No game image or extracted game assets are included. Experimental preview; Original 30 FPS is the supported default, and performance varies by device.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/sunpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 13 rebuilds from maintained forks with pinned dependencies, source notices and provenance records. No new gameplay feature or performance improvement is claimed.

apps.name: SpaghettiPad
apps.subtitle: Mario Kart 64 for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Mario Kart 64 on iPhone and iPad through SpaghettiKart, with Metal rendering, analog touch steering, controller routing and optional texture and character packs.

Requires your own supported Mario Kart 64 US 1.0 ROM. No ROM or optional packs are included. This is a developer preview; full multiplayer controller and performance coverage remains in testing.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/spaghettipad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 6 adds persistent mod selection, optional compatible character packs and the new fork-and-flag icon. Imported packs remain separate downloads.

apps.name: UTP
apps.subtitle: Unreal Tournament 99 for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Unreal Tournament 99 on iPhone and iPad, hosting the OldUnreal v469e ARM64 runtime with Metal rendering, touch controls, controller support, classic online play, and iPad keyboard and pointer controls.

Epic game data is not included. Follow the app's game-data setup or import files you are authorized to use. See the project for known rendering and device-compatibility limitations.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/utp#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Adds an iOS/iPadOS 15 compatibility build while retaining Preview 3 controls and gameplay. Selected for this source by the maintainer. The package still reports version 0.1.0 build 3, so installations of Preview 3 will not receive a version-based update notification.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: UT99 uses the local network for LAN games and direct server connections.

apps.name: BrawlerPad
apps.subtitle: Super Smash Bros. 64 for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Super Smash Bros. 64 on iPhone and iPad, built on BattleShip with Metal rendering, Files-based ROM setup, touch controls and controller support.

Requires your own legally obtained supported US ROM. No ROM or playable game-asset archive is included. This is a developer preview; broader physical controller testing remains open.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/brawlerpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 2 improves controller-slot ownership, held-input release and reconnection after sleep or foreground resume.

apps.name: MaskPad
apps.subtitle: Majora's Mask for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask on iPhone and iPad through 2 Ship 2 Harkinian, with Metal rendering, customizable touch controls, controller support and Files-based setup.

Requires your own legally obtained supported Majora's Mask ROM. No game data is included. Area-load frame pacing and broader device coverage remain under investigation.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/maskpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.1.2 repairs controller sleep, disconnect and reconnect handling while preserving valid player assignments.

apps.name: StarshipPad
apps.subtitle: Star Fox 64 for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Star Fox 64 on iPhone and iPad through Starship, with Metal rendering, touch flight controls, controller support and Files-based ROM import.

Requires your own legally obtained supported Star Fox 64 ROM. No game data is included. This is a developer preview; custom phone and tablet touch layouts remain experimental.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/starshippad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 5 refreshes the IPA from the merged controller-reconnect code and advances the build number to 5. No additional controller-code change is claimed.

apps.name: PaperPad
apps.subtitle: Paper Mario for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Paper Mario on iPhone and iPad, combining the pmret decompilation and Paper-Mario-ReCut runtime with Metal rendering, customizable touch controls and controller support.

Requires your own unmodified Paper Mario US 1.0 ROM, imported privately on the device. No game data is included. This is a developer preview.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/paperpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 2 improves controller ownership and input release after sleep, disconnect and foreground resume. Physical-iPhone hands-on acceptance and broader controller testing remain open.

apps.name: CaesarPad
apps.subtitle: Caesar III through Augustus, designed for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Caesar III through the Augustus engine, adapted for iPad with direct touch, interface scaling, map gestures and game-folder import.

Requires files from your own legally purchased Caesar III copy. No game data is included. This is an iPad-focused developer preview; iPhone use is not validated even though the package declares both device families.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/caesarpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public preview, including the game-folder importer fix. Supply your own Caesar III files after installation.

apps.name: DinoPad
apps.subtitle: Dinosaur Planet for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Dinosaur Planet on iPhone and iPad, built on Dinosaur Planet: Recompiled with Metal rendering, ROM import, touch controls and controller support.

Requires your own supported unmodified 64 MiB December 2000 Dinosaur Planet ROM. The public download plays the original game content; the separate DinoMod Enhanced / Restored Adventure modifications are not bundled. No ROM is included.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/dinopad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Version 0.1.2 improves ROM-import guidance, adds optional touch Z targeting lock and fixes second-session zoom/crop.

apps.name: Bellpad
apps.subtitle: Animal Crossing for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Animal Crossing for Nintendo GameCube adapted for iPhone and iPad as a native source port, with Metal rendering, touch controls, Files-based game-image import and Dolphin-compatible saves.

Requires your own supported original US revision 0 GAFE01 ISO/GCM. No game image or extracted assets are included. This is an experimental developer preview.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/bellpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: Preview 2 improves SDL3 controller ownership after sleep, disconnect and foreground resume. Broader hardware controller acceptance remains open.

apps.name: PeonPad
apps.subtitle: Warcraft II through Stratagus on iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Warcraft II on iPad through Stratagus and Wargus, with Metal-backed rendering and touch gestures for classic real-time strategy controls. iPad only.

Requires a complete data.Wargus folder extracted from your own Warcraft II copy on a computer. Copy it to PeonPad's Documents folder through Files or Finder. Game data is not included, and this developer preview has no in-app content importer.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/peonpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public data-free IPA, with Files-visible game-folder discovery and missing-data guidance. Requires a separately prepared data.Wargus folder.
